players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Raleigh returned to the lineup after a sore right side but went 0-for-5, extending his hitless stretch to 25 at-bats since April 27. The Mariners won 12-8 in a slugfest.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper was on base four times (2 singles, 2 walks) but the Phillies blew a late lead and lost 9-7 in 11 innings to Colorado. He was retired by closer Juan Mejia to end the game.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez delivered a clutch 2-run single in the 7th inning to break open the Giants' 5-2 win over Pittsburgh, supporting Robbie Ray's strong 6-inning start as SF snapped an 8-of-9 losing skid.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went hitless in 4 at-bats in the Mets' 3-1 extra-innings win over Arizona. Mark Vientos drove in 2 and Devin Williams earned the win pitching a scoreless inning.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle drew a walk via ABS challenge and reached on a fielder's choice but went hitless as the Tigers dropped a tight 4-3 game in Kansas City. Kris Bubic started for KC in Ragans' absence.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA had a standout night with a home run, 2 RBI and a HBP as Chicago routed Texas 7-1, extending their win streak to 10 games — their second such run this season. He has reached base in 12 straight games.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill collected the only Padres hit — a leadoff single in the 4th inning — as Cardinals starter McGreevy threw a one-hit shutout with 9 strikeouts. San Diego was dominated in a 6-0 loss.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernandez remains on the 10-day IL with a left groin strain; MRI confirmed a Grade 1 abductor strain. He is set to begin a rehab assignment with Single-A Rancho Cucamonga imminently.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice returned from a 4-game absence (bruised hand) but went 0-for-4 as Milwaukee's Jacob Misiorowski struck out 11 en route to a 6-0 Brewers shutout over New York.

sources.title: Brewers shut out Yankees, Misiorowski 11 K

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams earned his second win of the season (W 2-1), retiring all 3 batters he faced on just 8 pitches in the decisive inning of the Mets' 3-1 extra-innings victory over Arizona.

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler is on track to be activated from his rehab assignment on May 9 for his 2026 season debut, completing recovery from thoracic outlet syndrome surgery in September 2025.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans was placed on the 15-day IL with left elbow impingement after exiting Thursday's start vs Cleveland after 3 innings with left triceps/elbow soreness. Valgus extension overload (pitcher's elbow) was the diagnosis.

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns lines up to start Saturday May 9 at Houston. His last outing (May 3 vs Pittsburgh) was the best start of his young career — 7 shutout innings, 7 K — though the Reds lost 1-0 to complete a sweep.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi is on his regular schedule after tossing 8 shutout innings vs the Yankees on May 6 (7 K, 1 BB) for his 4th win of the season. Next start is lined up vs Arizona.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan showed encouraging stuff against Atlanta — 6 strikeouts in his first 8 outs, averaging 96 mph early — before tiring and departing in the 5th. The bullpen (Vesia W, Scott SV) closed out the 3-1 Dodgers win.

sources.title: Dodgers pitching limits Braves in victory

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers took the loss (1-2) in Toronto, surrendering a two-run homer to Vlad Guerrero Jr. in the 2nd inning. He walked the leadoff batter in the 7th and was lifted after 6.1 IP on 99 pitches.

sources.title: Angels vs Blue Jays box score

injuries.name: Teoscar Hernandez
injuries.note: Grade 1 abductor strain confirmed by MRI; placed on IL May 6; rehab assignment with Single-A Rancho Cucamonga pending

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: Exited May 7 start vs Cleveland after 3 innings with left triceps/elbow soreness; diagnosed with valgus extension overload (pitcher's elbow)
